newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira sees 97 performance on par with 96.
newsitem.headline: Kemira sees 97 performance on par with 96.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy can expect its 1997 performance to continue about the same as in 1996, when it booked its best-ever profit, its CEO Heimo Karinen said on Monday.

"The year '96 was the best for Kemira so far -- and the future, for '97, I suppose is to continue on about the same levels," he told Reuters Financial Television in an interview. "Of course it is not risk-free but there are some signs of recovery in pigments and also in the pulp and paper industry."
